description: Client-side script for product page interactions in an e-commerce website, including product info retrieval, cart updates, attribute selection, and image hover effects.

methods.name: get_item_code
methods.description: Retrieves the current item code based on selected variants or default item code.

methods.name: find_closest_match
methods.description: Finds the closest matching variant based on selected attribute and value.

methods.name: get_selected_attributes
methods.description: Gathers all selected attribute values for the item.

methods.name: toggle_update_cart
methods.description: Toggles visibility of cart update and add-to-cart buttons based on quantity.
